_comment: A stand-in `elevenlabs` CLI (evals/onboarding/bin) is on PATH, with stand-ins for brew/npm/pip that install nothing. Each case's `env` decides what `onboard status` and `onboard` print, so the agent runs the real commands and branches on their real JSON. Every call is appended to outputs/elevenlabs-calls.txt, which the grader reads along with the agent's final summary; expectations name the literal commands and fields the grader can find there.

evals.prompt: Add text to speech to my app. It's a Next.js project and I don't have an ElevenLabs account yet. The project has no env yet.
evals.expected_output: elevenlabs-calls.txt shows the CLI brought up to date through Homebrew (brew list --versions elevenlabs, brew upgrade elevenlabs/tap/elevenlabs) and then elevenlabs onboard --help, before any onboard status or onboard --product call
expectations: elevenlabs-calls.txt shows brew list --versions elevenlabs and brew upgrade elevenlabs/tap/elevenlabs before elevenlabs onboard --help, and nothing installed through another channel (NOT 'npm install -g') (NOT 'brew install')
elevenlabs-calls.txt shows elevenlabs onboard status .env.local --format json before elevenlabs onboard --product
elevenlabs-calls.txt shows elevenlabs onboard --product text-to-speech .env.local --format json
The key is in .env.local and .env.local was added to .gitignore
Continues to the text-to-speech SDK @elevenlabs/elevenlabs-js and offers to turn the sentence Welcome to ElevenLabs into speech as a first request that spends a few credits

expectations: elevenlabs-calls.txt shows elevenlabs onboard status --format json and then elevenlabs onboard --product text-to-speech --format json
